correctness.rationale: Normal form q1=gamma e1+sqrt(1−gamma²)e_{s+1}, q2=e2, q3 normal to plane. Center/scale B=(A−cI)/d, symmetric contraction; then H=cI+d[[a−t nu,b−t v],[b,k]], t=sqrt(1−gamma²)/gamma. For conjugate nonreal eigenvalues, (Im λ/d)²=t b v−b²−(a−k−t nu)²/4<=t b v−b². Bq2 contraction implies b²+v²<=1. Largest eigenvalue of [[−1,t/2],[t/2,0]] equals (sqrt(1+t²)−1)/2=(gamma^{-1}−1)/2. Orthogonal rank-two B=q2 h^T+h q2^T with h=b*q1+v*q3, b=sqrt((1−gamma)/2),v=sqrt((1+gamma)/2) attains bound with eigenvalues ±1. At gamma=1 ordinary orthogonal compression symmetric. Exact rational witness A [[6,−1,0],[−1,6,2],[0,2,6]], gamma=3/5 gives H [[6,−5/3],[1,6]] and sharp Im=sqrt(5/3). Independently verified rational discriminant and extremal numerical checks.
